rule: Among all retrieved works, find original tabulations of both time-mean bottom-wall separation and reattachment at ReH=10595 for the standard periodic hill (unit shape parameter). Require two internally compared runs on the same nominal mesh at fixed outer SGS, with a change to the wall treatment or near-wall package and a complete two-crossing reference identified in that table. Retain a reported missing bubble as an event without inventing a crossing. Disaggregate SGS or mesh settings within an eligible work. This is a retrospective, deliberately tabulated subset, not a frequency across flows or all wall tests.
search: Search the primary full texts for periodic hill, periodically arranged hills or flows over hills; check geometry and table headings in the identified papers and the design inventory. Preprints and published editions are distinguished. A table-only decision excludes otherwise valid digitized skin-friction studies. A second text search using hill and Reynolds-number variants found 29 candidates; their dispositions and additional full-text readings are recorded here.

noncanonical_and_graphical_sensitivity: Allowing changed mesh admits N502 (linked to the DG family), and N025 has a separate grid-stretching comparison. Requiring identical averaging windows can remove N497; retaining only single-variable active-wall changes would remove the joint FEL and RL implementations. See each row for the decision.

independent_broader_screen.P11: A formally exact boundary. Published paper §4 p. 8 tests the hill at Re_H=10595. Its table reports boundary-law constants, and its hill results plot velocities rather than a comparison table with both crossings.
independent_broader_screen.P14: Primary periodic-hill WMLES with distinct volume-filtered wall conditions and grids. Published Table II p. 15 lists grid/filter properties; results are profiles/curves. No tabular pair of measured crossings for the conditions. A wall-function error can be substantial while unavailable to this estimand.
